title: Top K Frequent Elements
description: Given an integer array nums and an integer k, return the k most frequent elements, in any order.

reference.use_case: Surfacing the most popular items in a large stream of events, such as trending hashtags, top search queries, or the API clients sending the most traffic.
system_examples: Redis — sorted-set leaderboards and the RedisBloom TOPK data type for tracking the most frequent items
X/Twitter trending topics — ranking the most-mentioned terms in a time window
Observability dashboards (Datadog top lists, Cloudflare analytics) — top endpoints, IPs, or user agents by request count
reference.explanation: Count frequencies with a hash map, then select the k largest with a size-k min-heap (O(n log k)) or bucket by frequency (O(n)) instead of sorting every distinct item. At scale this becomes heavy-hitter detection with approximate sketches such as Count-Min or Space-Saving.
